direction.situation: A rainy roadside in Colombo, just after Kasun handed Anudi her phone; their brief talk turned toward his small food business and now he answers her question about how he started.
direction.people: Kasun (on screen): modest, steady, wants to explain his start and future plans; stands right, facing left, hands at his sides. Anudi (off-frame, implied): grateful and curious, listening from just left of frame; her interest brought them closer but she is not visible in this shot.

flow.text: Kasun gathers himself for the answer. He holds his eyeline left, takes a small breath and lifts his chin slightly.

flow.how: honest pride with warm hope, a steady voice; he breathes in before starting, keeps gaze on her, lets a restrained smile grow and a slight lift of the chin underline the small achievement
flow.listener: Anudi shifts her weight a little closer, a soft, impressed smile appears and she looks for a moment at the three-wheeler behind him.

flow.text: Kasun lets the sentence stand. He holds position, lips settling while the restrained smile remains for a beat; the ambition hangs in the rain-lit air.

direction.camera: MCU, Kasun chest-and-head, eye level from road side, locked-off on sticks.
direction.sound: light continuous rain on metal, distant traffic, occasional three-wheeler engines; no music.
